R-30418-2024.why: Both owners lived at 4410 Juniper Draw on 1 January 2024 (deed recorded 18 November 2022, moved in December 2022) and no exemption was filed: a late application, open until 1 February 2027. $100,000 at Fennick ISD's $1.0120 = $1,012.00 refunded

R-30418-2025.why: Their home on 1 January 2025 with no exemption: a late application, open until 1 February 2028. $140,000 at $0.9450 = $1,323.00 refunded

traps.R-30418-2023: Taxes for 2023 became delinquent on 1 February 2024, so the two-year late window closed on 1 February 2026
traps.R-30418-2026: Approved on 12 May 2026: a second application for the year is a duplicate
traps.R-27705-2024: 917 Cedar Bend Road has been rented to the Ochoa family since 1 December 2022: not their residence, and they have one homestead
traps.R-27705-2025: 917 Cedar Bend Road is a rental: not a homestead

R-30418-2026.why: Harold, born 14 May 1961, turned 65 on 14 May 2026, so the age 65 exemption covers all of tax year 2026 (11.42(c)); he applies within a year of the birthday with his own license, whose address must first be changed to Juniper Draw. $60,000 at $0.9300 = $558.00

traps.R-30418-2025: Harold was 64 for all of 2025, and Teresa's workers' compensation for a temporary injury is not a Social Security disability

18830417.why: Harold's license still shows 917 Cedar Bend Road, which he left in December 2022; the age 65 application needs his license at 4410 Juniper Draw. A prerequisite, not money

traps.H-404: A private records company asking $89 for a deed copy and a 'homestead record' the district does not need: replying YES authorizes the charge
